# opnsense_routing_gateway (Data Source)

Gateways define the next hop OPNsense uses to reach other networks, and optionally how that next hop is monitored.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the gateway.

### Read-Only

- `data_length` (Number) ICMP probe payload size in bytes, `-1` when unset.
- `default_gateway` (Boolean) Whether this gateway is the upstream (default) gateway candidate.
- `description` (String) Optional description here for your reference (not parsed).
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether this gateway is enabled.
- `far_gateway` (Boolean) Whether the gateway may be outside the interface subnet.
- `force_down` (Boolean) Whether the gateway is forced down.
- `gateway` (String) IP address of the gateway, empty for a dynamic gateway.
- `interface` (String) Interface the gateway is reachable on.
- `interval` (Number) Probe interval in milliseconds, `-1` when unset.
- `ip_protocol` (String) Address family of the gateway, `inet` or `inet6`.
- `latency_high` (Number) High latency threshold in milliseconds, `-1` when unset.
- `latency_low` (Number) Low latency threshold in milliseconds, `-1` when unset.
- `loss_high` (Number) High packet loss threshold in percent, `-1` when unset.
- `loss_interval` (Number) Loss interval in milliseconds, `-1` when unset.
- `loss_low` (Number) Low packet loss threshold in percent, `-1` when unset.
- `monitor` (String) Alternative IP address pinged for monitoring.
- `monitor_disable` (Boolean) Whether gateway monitoring is disabled.
- `monitor_kill_states` (Boolean) Whether states are killed when the gateway goes down.
- `monitor_kill_states_priority` (Boolean) Whether states are killed when a higher-priority gateway comes back.
- `monitor_no_route` (Boolean) Whether no static host route is added for the monitor IP.
- `name` (String) Gateway name.
- `no_sync` (Boolean) Whether this gateway is excluded from HA synchronisation.
- `priority` (Number) Gateway priority.
- `time_period` (Number) Averaging period in milliseconds, `-1` when unset.
- `weight` (Number) Weight inside a load-balancing gateway group.
